title: Figures of Speech Used in the Bible: Explained and Illustrated
author: E. W. Bullinger
warning_label: Historical reference;Doctrinal caution;Use with discernment;OCR spot-check
recommended_use: A large reference guide to literary figures used in Scripture. Use it to identify possible figures and compare passages, while establishing interpretation from the KJV text in context and reviewing Bullinger's theological conclusions carefully.
rights_basis: The exact Internet Archive/Open Library edition was published by Eyre & Spottiswoode and E. & J. B. Young & Co. in 1898; the original edition is public domain in the United States.
